chapters.label: Allianz Arena
chapters.text: Munich, 2016, Champions League semi-final. Bayern attack and attack, but Atlético's keeper Jan Oblak is man of the match. Here's how he did it: a striker runs through... Oblak stays up. Saved!

chapters.label: Stay on your feet
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Oblak stays on his feet, knees bent, hands low. The striker waits for a dive that never comes.

chapters.label: Move first
chapters.text: So the striker must move first. He shoots low; Oblak drops fast and blocks it with his glove.

chapters.label: Make them move
chapters.text: Don't dive early! Stay on your feet as long as you can, so the attacker has to move first.
